**必选**:开始游戏前必须导入字体文件,或在系统字体列表里选一个;未选择时开始: **Required**: import a font file or pick one from the system font list before starting. Until then the Start button stays disabled.
**简体(GBK)/ 繁体(Big5)**:汉化补丁整包是 GBK / Big5: **Simplified (GBK) / Traditional (Big5)**: choose when the whole fan-translation patch is GBK / Big5; the wrong choice causes mojibake or missing glyphs.
**自动(推荐)**:按脚本内容采样判断编码,原版与大多数汉化包直接可用。: **Auto (recommended)**: samples the script to detect its encoding; works out of the box for originals and most translation patches.
**虚拟光标**:模拟鼠标指针,适合需要悬停 / 右键,或点击区域很小的老游戏。: **Virtual cursor**: emulates a mouse pointer; for games that need hovering/right-click or have tiny click targets.
**触摸**:直接点按,适合大多数作品。: **Touch**: direct taps; works for most games.
**隧道(sjis_ext)**:CP932 + 扩展隧道码的汉化路线,需要游戏: **Tunnel (sjis_ext)**: CP932 plus extended tunnel codes; requires sjis_ext.bin in the game root. Do not pick it for ordinary GBK patches.
GPU(安卓壳固定;CPU 不开放): GPU (fixed in the Android shell; CPU is not offered)

「GPU 接口」:自动优先 Vulkan,失败回退 GLES;出现**花屏、黑屏: **GPU API**: Auto prefers Vulkan and falls back to GLES. If you see **artifacts, a black screen, or driver crashes**, switch manually between GLES and Vulkan to compare.
「SIZE 双线性」:手机放大时更平滑;关闭更接近官方最近邻的像素观感。: **Bilinear SIZE**: smoother upscaling on phones; off is closer to the official nearest-neighbour look.
「存档压缩」:自动判定(推荐)。zlib / snappy 只在需要与特定工具链: **Save compression**: Auto-detect (recommended). Only set zlib/snappy manually when matching a specific toolchain; **loading always follows the actual stream**, so a wrong choice will not break existing saves.
「存档目录」默认是**游戏目录/save**;自定义目录只对当前游戏生效,换游戏: **Save folder** defaults to **game folder/save**. A custom folder applies only to the current game; switching games returns to that game's own save folder.
「导出翻译文件」生成带空译文槽的 translate.json(角色 / 选项: **Export translation** writes a translate.json with empty slots (characters / choices / narration); import it from the same entry when finished.
「帧率上限」:30 / 60 / 120;发热或耗电明显时降到 30 或 60。: **Frame rate limit**: 30 / 60 / 120; drop to 30 or 60 if the device gets hot or drains quickly.
「缺字补全」:主字体缺字时用系统其它字体补字形;翻译后出现方块字时打开。: **Glyph fallback**: fills missing glyphs from other system fonts; enable it if you see tofu boxes after translating.
「翻译文件」:导入 **translate.json** 才启用运行时替换,默认: **Translation file**: runtime replacement only starts after importing **translate.json**; nothing is loaded by default. Files are bound to the game root, so they never leak across games.
「视频解码」:自动(推荐);内置只支持 MPEG-1 + MP2,设备解码器异常: **Video decoding**: Auto (recommended). Built-in supports only MPEG-1 + MP2 and helps when the device decoder misbehaves; External uses MediaCodec, with wider codec support but device-dependent behaviour.
下面这些参数会直接影响启动、排版和存档;正文里的**加粗**是常见坑。: These settings directly affect startup, layout, and saves. **Bold** text marks common pitfalls.
不是 YU-RIS 游戏:未找到 data.ypf 或 ysbin 目录: Not a YU-RIS game: no data.ypf or ysbin folder found
乱码 → 文本编码;花屏 / 黑屏 → GPU 接口;读档失败 → 存档目录与压: Mojibake → Text encoding; artifacts/black screen → GPU API; save load failures → save folder and compression.

从游戏库导入或手动输入路径: Import from the library or enter a path manually
内核按真实路径读写游戏目录,不能使用 content:// URI: The core reads and writes game folders by real path and cannot use content:// URIs
内核没有返回失败原因(可开调试日志查看 logcat): The core did not return a failure reason (enable the debug log and check logcat)
内置:MPEG-1 program stream + MP2 音频;不依赖设备解: Built-in: MPEG-1 program stream + MP2 audio; no device decoder needed.

判断方法:看补丁目录是否带 sc_cn_ / sc_tw_ 前缀;拿不准就先用自: How to tell: check whether the patch folder uses the sc_cn_ / sc_tw_ prefix; when unsure, start with Auto and switch per the patch notes if text is garbled.
只删导入记录,不会删除游戏文件: Only removes the library entry; game files are kept
只影响写盘;读侧始终按实际流分流。原版带 YSSnp.dll 的作品是 snap: Write side only; loading always follows the actual stream. Games shipping YSSnp.dll use snappy.
只清全局默认;单游戏设置保留: Clears global defaults only; per-game settings are kept
只清当前游戏的设置,不改全局默认: Clears only this game's settings, not the global defaults
只清除配置,不删除文件: Clears the setting only; the file is kept
同一项两边都设置时**单游戏配置优先**;详情页最下方「恢复全局默认」只清当前游: When both sides set the same item, **the per-game value wins**; "Reset to global" at the bottom of the details page clears only this game's overrides.
启动失败:看游戏界面弹出的错误,再回本页按关键词调整。: Startup failure: read the error dialog in the game view, then return here and adjust the matching setting.
字体只需在全局设置里配一次;个别游戏要换字体时,再在详情页覆盖。: Configure the font once in Global settings; override it on a game's details page only when that game needs a different one.
字体默认在**游戏库右上角齿轮 → 全局设置**里配置一次,所有游戏沿用;单游戏: Set the default font once under **library top-right gear → Global settings**; all games inherit it, and a single game can override it on its details page.
对所有游戏生效;单个游戏的设置优先: Applies to all games; per-game settings take priority

推荐**自己导入等宽字体**(Noto Sans Mono CJK、思源等宽、更: **Import a monospaced font** (Noto Sans Mono CJK, Source Han Mono, Sarasa Mono, etc.); the system font list is only a fallback, and proportional fonts often misalign in fixed-width layout.
推荐:导入自己的字体(等宽): Recommended: import your own monospaced font
推荐导入等宽字体;单个游戏需要换字体时,在游戏详情页覆盖即可。: Monospaced fonts are recommended; to use another font for one game, override it on that game's details page.

游戏自带字体不一定出现在系统字体列表里;找不到就导入 **.ttf / .otf: A game's bundled font may not appear in the system font list; if you cannot find it, import a **.ttf / .otf / .ttc** file.

状态浮层、调试日志、VM 归因、资产计时、tick 分段、CG 计时都是**排查: Status overlay, debug log, VM profiling, asset timing, tick split, and CG timing are **diagnostics**, all off by default, and do not affect normal play.
